output.one_liner: Brex is a unified spend platform providing corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay with REST APIs.

auth.notes: OAuth2 required for partner integrations via authorization_code or client_credentials grants; bearer_token (user tokens) for direct user API access.

evidence.snippet: The Brex MCP server supports two authentication methods. OAuth (recommended)
Brex currently supports 2 different authorization grant types: Authorization Code Grant and Client Credentials Grant

access.notes: Account admin or card admin must accept developer API agreement in Settings > Developer, then generate bearer tokens. No free sandbox; only production API server at https://api.brex.com. Requires Brex customer account (typically paid). Partner integrations contact Brex developer support.

evidence.snippet: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin. Go to Developer > Settings.
If your company has not accepted the developer API agreement, please review the terms and conditions. These must be accepted to use the developer API.
An account admin or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement in Settings → Developer.
Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 1000 requests per 60 seconds per client ID and account; 1000 transfers, 100 international wires per 24 hours; 5000 cards per 24 hours.

evidence.snippet: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.
Accounting API, Budgets API, Expenses API, Fields API, Onboarding API, Payments API, Team API, Transactions API, Travel API, Webhooks API.
Per Client ID and Brex account, we allow: Up to 1,000 requests in 60 seconds.
The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards.
The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp and supports any MCP-compatible client.
A MCP server for interacting with Brex expense tracking platform
A model context protocol server for Brex API. Optimized for safe, small, read-only responses.

buildability.rationale: Composio has successfully built a 84-tool toolkit; Brex API is fully documented with REST/OpenAPI, broad surface, and official MCP support.

overview_evidence.snippet: Brex is the first fully unified spend platform — with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.
